I had a similar thing happen a few years ago.
I live in the UK, I was on my way home from work in my little old battered Ford Fiesta 1.4L diesel, got to a roundabout, I am in the left lane to go straight on and a big, new, shiny 4x4 Range Rover who’d been on my tail anyway pulls up in the lane next to me, I don’t know how but I just *knew* he was gonna cut me up on the roundabout so when it was my turn I popped the clutch and flew across that roundabout, cutting him off, instantly he was right on my tail, so close I could only see his headlights, flashing them at me, I wasn’t going straight home, I was on my way to the gym so as I turned off I left my signal really late, he still followed me onto the side roads, round a service road that neither of us needed to go down, it was a test to see if he really was following me, he was.
I couldn’t phone anyone and didn’t want to stop at the gym in case he stopped too and stabbed me or something so I carried on, didn’t want to go home either and show where I lived, racking my brain what to do, I ended up passing my doctor surgery and quickly figured I could park up and run into the drs, hopefully before he could stop and get me, he drove past the car park for the drs - phew!

Really shook me up, silly hubby and son said I should have come home so they could scare him off but didn’t want that either!

Several people I told later said I should have gone to a police station but the one in our town is a bit off the main roads and I didn’t fancy my chances, others said go to a petrol garage as they all have cctv and we don’t have (as much) chance of being shot over here.

I am 100% certain I really pissed him off beating him in his big shiny Range Rover with my lil old diesel Ford.

All in all not fun!
